slots.jd.residential-builder.about:
About us and the job
Fieldstone Builders is an owner-run residential builder in Lancaster, PA. We build and finish homes, and we care about work that is square, solid and done right the first time. We are looking for a master carpenter to run carpentry on our sites. This is on-site work every day, alongside our crews and apprentices.
slots.jd.residential-builder.duties:
What the job involves
- Direct carpentry crews and apprentices on site, set the day's work and check it before it is signed off
- Teach apprentices good habits with tools, layout and finish work
- Keep the site safe, tidy and in line with our safety rules, and stop work when something is not right
- Read plans, lay out the work and plan each job from start to finish
- Order lumber and materials so crews have what they need when they need it
- Talk with the owner and other trades to keep jobs on schedule
slots.jd.residential-builder.needs:
What you need
- 9 or more years of hands-on carpentry experience in residential building
- Rafter cutting, stair building and concrete forming done to plan without close supervision
- Door and window installation, subfloor installation and cabinet installation to a finished standard
- A current Construction Safety Card, which is required for this job
- A Crew Supervisor Certificate is preferred but not required
slots.r1.b1: Frame walls and floors on remodeling jobs, checking framing layouts before cutting to shorten wall and floor framing time by 20 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Run daily site walk-throughs and keep jobsite safety standards in place for every crew working on remodeling jobs.
slots.r1.b3: Install doors, windows and trim, and use concrete forming where openings sit on new footings, reducing callbacks on installed openings by 50 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Plan jobs, order lumber against the plans, and schedule scaffold erection so crews can start exterior work without delay.
slots.r1.i1: Lead carpentry work at Marlow Remodeling, framing walls and floors for home remodeling jobs.
slots.r1.i2: Build forms for concrete at Marlow Remodeling and set them to line and level before each pour.
slots.r2.b1: Built concrete forms for footings and steps and applied stair building skills to set rise and run, cutting form rework by 25 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Ordered lumber and materials for framing crews, using layout and measuring to take accurate counts from plans and limit overorders.
slots.r2.b3: Framed walls and floors and handled rafter cutting for roof systems, raising daily framing output by 45 percent.
slots.r2.b4: Kept openings guarded and the site safe during door and window installation, securing frames before crews left each day.
slots.r2.i1: Built forms for concrete footings and walls as a journeyman carpenter at Harlow Framing Company.
slots.r2.i2: Kept the site safe for framing crews at Harlow Framing Company while carrying out journeyman carpentry work.
slots.r3.b1: Installed doors, windows and trim after framing rough openings to size, cutting installation time by 45 percent.
slots.r3.b2: Read plans and took measurements under journeyman supervision while following jobsite safety rules on every task.
slots.r3.b3: Built forms for concrete footings and slabs, learning concrete forming methods that reduced form material waste by 10 percent.
slots.r3.b4: Ordered lumber and materials for crews and staged parts for scaffold erection ahead of exterior work.
slots.r3.i1: Kept the site safe and tidy while learning the carpentry trade as an apprentice at Tillman Brothers Carpentry.
slots.r3.i2: Helped order lumber and materials for carpentry crews as an apprentice at Tillman Brothers Carpentry.
slots.summary.1: Master carpenter with 9 years of experience planning jobs and checking the work of crews and apprentices. Skilled in layout and measuring, framing and jobsite safety, with a record of keeping work square, level and to plan.
slots.summary.2: Carpentry professional at master level with 9 years in the trade, planning jobs and inspecting the work of others before sign-off. Brings layout and measuring, framing and jobsite safety to every site, from first cut to final check.
